asr_bad_lines: because one of them's done by to night, and the one sitting right next to it has got a month.
Ruskula, Rusmalai, Sundaesh, those get two days and only in the fridge.
Milk Burfy paid a boondi luddoo about four days.
Mostly it's water. A ruskula is about half water, kalakund about a quarter, and milk burfy around fifteen per cent.
Basan luddu is roasted flour, ghee and sugar. No milk and hardly any water to begin with.
Burphy sits right in between, around 0.8, too dry for most bacteria but not for mold.
Screenshot this. Kalakun today, Ruskula by day two, Burfi by day four, Kaju by the week, Luddu whenever you like.
